title: 2010 BET Hip-Hop Awards: Cypher 5
description: The 5th and final cypher from the 2010 BET Hip-hop Awards, hosted by DJ Premier. Kanye spits verses alongside Pusha T, Big Sean, Common, and Cyhi The Prynce. He would reuse this verse for the unreleased Good Ass Job era song "Eyes Closed", which he eventually gave to Snoop Dogg who released it as "Eyez Closed" in 2011 and kept the reused Kanye verse. He would also reuse this same exact verse for his feature on the song "sailing NOT selling" by Jhene Aiko.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 Infant
description: Released on August 24th, 2016, alongside the Yeezy Boost 350 Infant ‘Pirate Black’ 2016 colorway, the Yeezy Boost 350 Infant ‘Turtle Dove’ is an exact replica of the adult model in infant sizes from 5 to 10. The design features a blue-gray/turtle dove Primeknit upper with branded suede patches on the medial sides, patterned rope laces, red accented heel tabs, and a white Boost outsole.

title: YEEZY 500
description: Initially released in February 2018 as a limited pre-order in New York and Los Angeles, the Yeezy 500 ‘Blush’ underwent a general release in April 2018. Its moniker is a fitting one, as the monochromatic light taupe finish barely registers as a color. The subdued palette is contrasted by a bold silhouette, featuring a paneled mesh and suede upper combined with a hefty midsole reminiscent of adidas’ Feet You Wear' technology of the 1990s.

title: YEEZY BOOST 380
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 ‘Onyx Reflective’ makes use of a re-engineered Primeknit upper in a blend of black and mahogany tones. Semi-translucent woven construction distinguishes the post dyed monofilament side stripe that accents the lateral side panel, while reflective fibers add a high-vis element to the murky palette. Responsive cushioning comes courtesy of a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a smoky rubber cage and reinforced by a herringbone gum rubber outsole.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 KIDS
description: Launching in December 2020, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids ‘Bred’ brings back a simplistic two-tone colorway of the lifestyle silhouette first released in 2017. The reissue is unchanged from the original, featuring a black Primeknit upper with ‘SPLY-350’ inscribed in reverse-print red lettering on the lateral side panel. An additional pop of red appears via embroidered detailing on a pull tab at the heel. The sneaker rides on a full-length Boost midsole, entirely wrapped in a semi-translucent rubber cage.

title: YEEZY 700 V3
description: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Mono Safflower’ represents the spiritual successor to the ‘Safflower’ colorway from 2018. Complementary cream and orange tones are applied to an upper built with monofilament engineered mesh and fortified with a semi-translucent RPU cage that glows in the dark. Interior bootie construction provides a snug, comfortable fit. Lightweight cushioning arrives via a PU-encapsulated EVA midsole, supported by a herringbone-traction gum rubber outsole.
